hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.js) npx prettier --write "$f"; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.js) npx eslint --fix "$f"; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.spec.ts|*.test.ts) npx jest "$f"; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
